name: imageo
description: SPFx 1.24.1 Application Customizer that turns SharePoint page context into brand-styled images with Microsoft Foundry MAI-Image-2.7-Flash.
author: Nello D'Andrea

scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix spfx test
scripts.deploy: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_dry_run==='true'){console.error('Use \"npm run deploy:dry-run\" — npm consumes --dry-run before npx sees it.');process.exit(2)}" && cd spfx && npx -y github:ferrarirosso/spfx-foundry-deploy#05f52b0ae6da1b10385a1e879da6eedc589dedc5 deploy --config ./deploy.config.local.json
